composed_text.description: Composed reminder body, ready for outbound.deliver. SMS-friendly length. Empty string only on the on_failure defensive default — the schema allows minLength:1 because on_failure bypasses output-schema validation per [REFERENCE_EXAMPLES.md §3].

suggested_channel.description: Channel hint into outbound.dispatcher; dispatcher decides actual channel from member preferences.

tone_note.description: Audit-only note about tone choice or channel coercion. Carries the skill_failure_defensive_default sentinel on the on_failure path.
